components.name: Brand Lockup
components.description: The compact product signature for persistent app navigation.
components.html: Infinite Quest Nexus
components.css: .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: var(--text-primary, #101418); font-family: 'Chakra Petch', sans-serif; font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #2346a8); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-brand-mark { width: 27px; height: 24px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); gap: 2px; align-items: end; } .ds-brand-mark i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--text-primary, #101418); } .ds-brand-mark i:nth-child(2), .ds-brand-mark i:nth-child(4) { height: 48%; background: var(--accent, #2346a8); } .ds-brand-mark i:nth-child(3) { height: 72%; } .ds-brand b { color: var(--accent, #2346a8); font-weight: inherit; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: An operational destination marked by a growing accent baseline.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position: relative; min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 20px; color: var(--text-secondary, #46515c); font-family: 'Geologica', sans-serif; font-size: 0.79rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.055em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; height: 3px; content: ''; background: var(--accent, #2346a8); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item:focus-visible, .ds-nav-item[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--text-primary, #101418); outline: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover::after, .ds-nav-item:focus-visible::after, .ds-nav-item[aria-current='page']::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-item:active { color: var(--accent-hover, #17327f); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A square accent action for retry and other decisive operations.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { padding: 12px 18px; color: var(--text-on-accent, #f5f7fb); background: var(--accent, #2346a8); border: 1px solid var(--accent, #2346a8); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Chakra Petch', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; transition: background-color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { color: var(--text-on-accent, #f5f7fb); background: var(--accent-hover, #17327f); border-color: var(--accent-hover, #17327f); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { color: var(--text-on-accent, #f5f7fb); background: var(--accent-hover, #17327f); border-color: var(--accent-hover, #17327f); outline: 3px solid var(--text-primary, #101418); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { color: var(--text-on-accent, #f5f7fb); background: var(--accent-hover, #17327f); border-color: var(--accent-hover, #17327f); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: The focused query control with the system's only lifted shadow.
components.css: .ds-search { width: min(100%, 620px); height: 52px; display: flex; align-items: center; color: var(--text-primary, #101418); background: var(--surface-entry, rgba(248, 250, 251, 0.96)); border: 1px solid var(--text-primary, #101418); border-radius: 0; transition: border-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent, #2346a8); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px var(--focus-shadow, rgba(35, 70, 168, 0.2)); } .ds-search svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; margin-left: 18px; fill: none; stroke: var(--accent, #2346a8); stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: square; stroke-linejoin: miter; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; height: 100%; padding: 0 18px; color: var(--text-primary, #101418); background: transparent; border: 0; outline: 0; font-family: 'Geologica', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--text-secondary, #46515c); opacity: 1; } .ds-search kbd { margin-right: 14px; padding: 4px 8px; color: var(--text-secondary, #46515c); background: var(--surface-muted, #e6ebf0); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #b8c5d0); border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Geologica', sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; } .ds-visually-hidden { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Indexed Content Entry
components.description: A complete clickable atlas cell pairing distinctive media with concise evidence.

components.css: .ds-entry { width: min(100%, 390px); display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr; padding: clamp(13px, 1.33vw, 21px); color: var(--text-primary, #101418); background: var(--surface-entry, rgba(248, 250, 251, 0.96)); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #8798a8); border-radius: 0; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-entry:hover, .ds-entry:focus-visible { background: var(--surface-entry-hover, #ffffff); outline: none; } .ds-entry:focus-visible { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px var(--accent, #2346a8); } .ds-entry:active { background: var(--surface-entry, rgba(248, 250, 251, 0.96)); } .ds-entry-cover { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; overflow: hidden; display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--accent, #2346a8); background-color: var(--artwork-fallback, #e1e7ec); background-image: linear-gradient(to right, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #2346a8) 16%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #2346a8) 16%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 18px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--text-primary, #101418); clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 22px) 0, 100% 22px, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-entry-glyph { font-family: 'Chakra Petch', sans-serif; font-size: 5rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; } .ds-coordinate { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; padding: 7px 10px; color: var(--text-on-accent, #f5f7fb); background: var(--accent, #2346a8); font-family: 'Chakra Petch', sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-entry-copy { min-height: 166px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding-top: 18px; } .ds-entry-copy strong { margin-bottom: 0.7rem; font-family: 'Literata', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-entry-description { margin-bottom: 1.6rem; color: var(--text-secondary, #46515c); border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #b8c5d0); color: var(--text-secondary, #46515c); font-family: 'Geologica', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.055em; } .ds-entry-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: var(--accent-hover, #17327f); font-family: 'Chakra Petch', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; } .ds-entry-action svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: square; stroke-linejoin: miter; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-entry:hover .ds-entry-action svg, .ds-entry:focus-visible .ds-entry-action svg { transform: translate(3px, -3px); narrative.overview:
Infinite Quest Nexus should feel like an atlas being actively indexed: precise, durable, and visibly assembled from paper, ink, editorial indigo marks, and measured cells. The system makes story records feel authored and persistent without imitating a fantasy manuscript; its confidence comes from modernist construction, disciplined information labels, and artwork given room to remain the richest material.

The interface is flat, operational, and intentionally square. Grid lines expose the underlying structure instead of hiding it, while a restrained diagonal slash, clipped corner, or semantic accent state creates recognition without turning every surface into decoration. Responsive changes preserve complete cells and complete content units rather than squeezing desktop fragments into narrow columns.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-white fields, near-black ink, cool construction rules, and sparing editorial indigo signals.
Visible modular cells and square divisions that explain the layout.
Literata for a restrained literary display voice that connects the interface to reading and writing.
Geologica for readable prose and Chakra Petch for operational hierarchy.
Flat tonal depth, clipped cover geometry, and one focused search shadow.
Whole-cell responsive recomposition with purposeful, reduced-motion-safe reveals.

rules.name: The Indigo Signal Rule
rules.body: Editorial indigo is a state and orientation color, not a general surface fill; preserve its authority by using it sparingly.

rules.name: The Artwork Priority Rule
rules.body: Full-color user-provided world artwork may exceed the restrained interface palette; theme changes never recolor, replace, bundle, or otherwise alter it. Media overlays and image treatment remain theme-invariant, while keyboard focus is shown on the enclosing cell.

rules.name: The Semantic Theme Rule
rules.body: Future pages and reusable components consume semantic tokens rather than World Library selectors, obsolete aliases, or literal light and dark colors.

rules.name: The Literary Display Rule
rules.body: Literata names worlds and major spaces; keep it measured, never oversized or ornamental.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Literata names, Geologica explains, and Chakra Petch orients and operates.

rules.name: The Whole-Cell Rule
rules.body: At every viewport, move and resize complete cells or content units; never leave controls, labels, or artwork as squeezed remnants of a desktop composition.

rules.name: The Visible Construction Rule
rules.body: Spacing and one-pixel rules should make the organizing grid legible without overpowering content.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Do not use shadows to manufacture card hierarchy; use construction rules, tonal fields, and explicit focus state instead.

rules.name: The Square Rule
rules.body: Buttons, fields, navigation, tags, messages, and content containers remain unrounded.

rules.name: The One Cut Rule
rules.body: When a silhouette needs distinction, clip one purposeful corner or add one diagonal mark; do not scatter ornamental angles across every edge.

dos: Do build hierarchy with semantic surfaces, text roles, editorial indigo signals, visible rules, and complete modular cells.
Do use Literata at a restrained scale for major spaces, world names, and literary identity moments.
Do keep Geologica for explanatory prose and Chakra Petch for operational labels and actions.
Do preserve square controls, one-pixel construction rules, clipped media corners, and clear keyboard focus.
Do recompose complete content units for narrow screens and honor reduced-motion preferences.
Do let world artwork remain richer than the surrounding interface palette.
donts: Don't introduce rounded-card dashboard styling, pill controls, or soft floating panels.
Don't spread the accent across large passive surfaces or use it as decoration without state or wayfinding value.
Don't add ambient card shadows; reserve the focused shadow for active search or an equivalent primary query field.
Don't make literary display type oversized, ornamental, or faux-antique; it should support reading and creative writing without becoming costume.
Don't shrink a multi-column composition until its controls and copy become cramped; switch the whole-cell arrangement instead.
Don't elevate World Library-specific column counts, hero placement, or entry order into global design law.
